What we do

We promote press freedom, strengthen independent media and protect journalists through advocacy, capacity building and research. Our programmes

Freedom of Expression, Tech and Digital Rights

Protecting the right to free expression and access to information, and building a freer, safer online space for everyone, especially women.

Media for Democracy and Good Governance

Strengthening the media’s capacity to contribute to participatory, accountable governance.

Sixteen countries, one region

We support independent media and protect press freedom across the fifteen ECOWAS states and Mauritania, including some of the region’s most challenging environments.
